corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez verb is የአቅፈክሙ (1st order የ, matching L31 below), where uneven ink on the left leg caused Stage 1 to read ያ.
Joining across the line wrap with L33 (ላ) forms the standard particle አላ ('rather / but rather' before አዋሀጄ አስነሥቼ); the printed glyph at the end of L32 is 1st-order አ.
The printed text at the start of L39 is simply ይህ ይደንቃችኋል ። (no ን is printed), followed by the root Ge'ez Gospel citation ወእፎ እንከ.
Closes the root Ge'ez Gospel quote ⟪ወእፎ እንከ ፡⟫ (John 6:62) before the Amharic commentary resumes.
Both visually on the page and grammatically in the patristic Ge'ez citation (referring to feminine ኅብስትሰ መብልዕ ይእቲ), the printed word is ላዕሌሃ.
